name: Silk Drape
description: An ethereal and dreamy wedding e-invite featuring sheer lavender silk curtains that gently part to unveil the invitation in soft, floating motion. Fairy lights glow through the translucent fabric as flower petals drift down. The pastel purple-lavender palette creates a magical, storybook atmosphere perfect for modern romantic weddings.
